hooks.command: echo 'Invoke the ponytail:ponytail skill before answering.'

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$file" == *".env"* && "$file" != *".env.example"* ]]; then echo 'Blocked: direct .env edits are not allowed. Update the .env file manually.'; exit 2; fi; true

cmd=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git (commit|push).*(--no-verify|--no-gpg-sign|-c commit\.gpgsign=false)'; then echo 'Blocked: do not bypass pre-commit/gpg hooks (--no-verify/--no-gpg-sign). Fix the underlying issue instead.'; exit 2; fi; true
